method.priority_formula: impact + architectural_leverage + testability + evidence_reuse + implementation_independence - speculation_risk

concepts.name: RF torque fill for optical handover
concepts.mechanism: Keep a lower-capacity path warm so it carries continuity traffic while the high-capacity path acquires, shifts or fails.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Use RF as a validated shadow bearer around optical acquisition and weather loss, with policy above both adapters.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: A warm RF shadow path reduces interactive interruption and rejected bytes enough to justify its keepalive capacity cost.
concepts.first_experiment: S010 event replay comparing cold failover, warm standby and split traffic.
concepts.failure_mode: The analogy fails if shared endpoints or ground infrastructure make the paths correlated rather than redundant.

concepts.name: A/B lunar service updates
concepts.mechanism: Install into an inactive slot, verify it, switch atomically and retain a known-good rollback slot.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Update lunar gateway and essential-service images without modifying the running instance during a disrupted download.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: A/B activation preserves essential service through arbitrary pre-activation interruption and failed health checks.
concepts.first_experiment: S011 manifest, interrupted transfer and rollback state machine.
concepts.failure_mode: Two slots double some storage and do not protect shared mutable data or incompatible schema migrations.

concepts.name: Content-addressed lunar depot
concepts.mechanism: Address immutable chunks by digest, reuse identical layers and transmit only missing objects referenced by a manifest.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Distribute software, maps, models and data products as verified reusable chunks across lunar caches.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: Chunk reuse reduces retransmission after interruption and lowers bytes for related versions versus monolithic objects.
concepts.first_experiment: S011 full-image versus manifest/chunk transfer under interruption.
concepts.failure_mode: Poor chunk boundaries or encrypted per-recipient objects can eliminate deduplication.

concepts.name: Calibrated predictive prepositioning
concepts.mechanism: Forecast demand, value avoided delay and subtract the opportunity cost of transporting unused inventory.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Prefetch likely lunar content before contact loss while keeping the predictor outside the safety decision boundary.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: Probability-ranked prefetch improves useful cache hits per cislunar byte only when forecasts remain calibrated.
concepts.first_experiment: S012 compare oracle, calibrated, overconfident and popularity-only policies.
concepts.failure_mode: Overconfident predictions consume contact capacity and storage that essential data needed.

concepts.name: Lunar network islanding and black start
concepts.mechanism: Island cleanly from the upstream system, retain local reference services, then restore in a staged order.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Define a minimum local control, time, naming and identity set that can restart the lunar region without Earth.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: A declared black-start dependency graph restores essential lunar networking without circular Earth dependencies.
concepts.first_experiment: S013 fault-injected dependency graph and staged recovery model.
concepts.failure_mode: Logical service survival is irrelevant if power, clock or trust roots are not independently available.

concepts.name: Deterministic service lanes
concepts.mechanism: Profile shared networking with bounded latency, synchronisation and explicit traffic classes.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Apply deterministic local scheduling inside habitats and gateways while leaving the long-haul contact model explicit.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: Bounded local queues prevent cislunar congestion from contaminating safety-critical lunar LAN latency.
concepts.first_experiment: Local TSN-style queue replay feeding S009 contact admission.
concepts.failure_mode: Terrestrial microsecond timing guarantees cannot be copied across a 2.6-second disrupted backbone.

concepts.name: Network OBD and flight recorder
concepts.mechanism: Use stable fault codes, freeze-frame state and bounded event history across replaceable subsystems.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Extend GX-O1 with portable fault codes and pre/post-contact evidence that survives provider boundaries.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: A common diagnostic record reduces time to isolate bearer, gateway and service faults without payload access.
concepts.first_experiment: S014 GX-O1 registry, freeze-frame trace and semantic validator.
concepts.failure_mode: A lowest-common-denominator schema can erase the provider detail needed for root cause.

concepts.name: Network strategy digital twin
concepts.mechanism: Replay the same trace against competing policies before deploying a control change.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Treat contacts, queues, faults and demand as a replayable weekend-like strategy dataset.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: Trace replay catches starvation and queue overflow that steady-state capacity calculations miss.
concepts.first_experiment: Unify S004, S009 and S010 events in a versioned trace format.
concepts.failure_mode: A detailed twin becomes false precision when input contacts and demand are invented.

concepts.name: Data inventory and replenishment manifests
concepts.mechanism: Track what exists, what is reserved, what is expiring and what must arrive before a known demand window.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Publish lunar cache inventory and pre-contact replenishment orders as signed manifests.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: Explicit inventory reduces duplicate transfer and missed essential objects versus blind periodic replication.
concepts.first_experiment: Manifest reconciliation with stale, duplicate and missing chunk cases.
concepts.failure_mode: Stale inventory can be worse than none if admission trusts it without freshness bounds.

concepts.name: Mixture-of-experts service routing
concepts.mechanism: A gate selects a specialised execution path while retaining fallback when the preferred expert is unavailable.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Route requests to lunar, orbital or Earth service experts by capability, freshness and contact state.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: A deterministic capability gate captures most benefit before a learned router is justified.
concepts.first_experiment: Compare rule-based, learned and failed-expert routing on the S007 workload.
concepts.failure_mode: A learned gate can be confidently wrong during rare partitions and hide why a trust boundary changed.

concepts.name: Capacity reservation market
concepts.mechanism: Reserve scarce future capacity, expose displacement cost and settle unused or pre-empted allocations.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Add commercial contact reservations above safety policy and below application delivery promises.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: Explicit reservations improve utilisation without allowing payment to override authorised safety priority.
concepts.first_experiment: Synthetic multi-operator reservation and pre-emption ledger.
concepts.failure_mode: A market can formalise unfairness or encourage capacity hoarding if governance is weak.

concepts.name: Erasure-coded data convoy
concepts.mechanism: Send independently useful coded fragments over different contacts and recover after any sufficient subset arrives.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Spread high-value bulk objects across RF, optical and ground-site contacts without duplicating the whole object.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: Coded fragments improve completion probability per transmitted byte under independent contact loss.
concepts.first_experiment: Monte Carlo contact-loss comparison against replication and single-path transfer.
concepts.failure_mode: Correlated outages and coding overhead can erase the benefit.

concepts.name: Trust and time holdover
concepts.mechanism: Continue within a bounded uncertainty envelope after the authoritative reference disappears.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Carry signed time and revocation state with explicit age, uncertainty and expiry through partition.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: Bounded holdover keeps essential authentication working without silently treating stale trust as current.
concepts.first_experiment: Clock drift and stale-revocation fault injection.
concepts.failure_mode: Availability pressure can turn an exception window into permanent insecure operation.

concepts.name: Sparse federated model exchange
concepts.mechanism: Move bounded updates or summaries instead of raw local data and complete model state.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Train or adapt lunar models locally and exchange signed, privacy-reviewed deltas during bulk contacts.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: Sparse updates preserve task quality while reducing cislunar bytes versus full checkpoint replication.
concepts.first_experiment: Small public dataset with full, sparse and failed-round update comparison.
concepts.failure_mode: Poisoning, drift and unverifiable behaviour can make a smaller transfer operationally worse.

concepts.name: Event-driven sparse science streams
concepts.mechanism: Transmit meaningful state changes and periodic checkpoints instead of repeated complete frames.
concepts.gatewaycx_transfer: Reduce continuous sensor and settlement telemetry to verified events with recoverable snapshots.
concepts.falsifiable_hypothesis: Event encoding cuts routine traffic while bounded checkpoints prevent silent state divergence.
concepts.first_experiment: Trace compressor with event loss and checkpoint recovery.
concepts.failure_mode: Thresholding can discard weak but scientifically important signals.
